title: Geostationary Full-Disk Imagery
description: Full-disk geostationary satellite imagery from GOES, Himawari, and G2-KA satellites, stored in Icechunk format and converted from public AWS archives. Data is Level 1b radiance/reflectance imagery processed by Satpy. Coverage is incomplete but being expanded with historical and near-real-time imagery over time.
